packages.title: DfT RTFO statistics 2025: Fourth provisional release — scope and status QA
facts: DfT published the fourth provisional RTFO statistics release for 2025 on 13 May 2026.
The release is based on data available as of 27 April 2026 and is explicitly incomplete.
The complete finalised 2025 dataset is scheduled for November 2026.
SAF is excluded from the 2025 RTFO series because the SAF Mandate took effect from January 2025.
Renewable-fuel supply statistics are not direct parcel greenhouse-gas observations.
